title: Audit loop environment after iteration 0000 setup
body:
## Goal
Report how the loop uses its environment: tokens and context per role, where sessions wait, and unused substrate. Write the report to audit/latest.md.
## Acceptance
- [ ] audit/latest.md exists and lists per-role token and wait findings
- [ ] Each finding names its evidence path
## Verification
`test -s audit/latest.md`
## Context
- policy/roles/audit/SKILL.md: audit work rules
- execution/roles/worker/SKILL.md: the worker role being measured
## Budget
- Read-only over loop records; no more than 30 turns
